voyager-1-journey.title: Voyager's Journey
voyager-1-journey.description: A guided reconstruction of Voyager 1 from launch through Jupiter and Saturn flybys into interstellar space.

waypoints.label: Jupiter Flyby
waypoints.highlight: Gravitational slingshot increased Voyager 1's heliocentric energy and bent its trajectory toward Saturn.

waypoints.label: Saturn Flyby & Titan Diversion
waypoints.highlight: The Saturn encounter and Titan targeting shaped Voyager 1's post-encounter departure trajectory.

waypoints.label: Pale Blue Dot
waypoints.highlight: Looking back at Earth from roughly 40 AU: a pale blue dot in a sunbeam.

waypoints.label: Heliopause / Interstellar Space
waypoints.highlight: Voyager 1 crossed into interstellar space in August 2012.

waypoints.label: Present-day position · estimate
waypoints.highlight: Far beyond the planets, travelling north of the ecliptic. Position is illustrative, not a live ephemeris.

waypoints.label: Continuing outward
waypoints.highlight: Voyager continues coasting outward even after its instruments and radio fall silent.

display.uncertainty: Approximate; ignores Earth’s orbital motion (up to about 2 AU change from baseline) and velocity changes.
